pipeline.gate: Identifiers found in anything that left the pipeline
Scans with SUV more than 10% off
Patients with baseline and follow-up paired
Invented facts kept in the knowledge graph
New terms induced (of 2 in the documents)
Ablations worse than the pipeline on some measure (share)

labels.naive: Read the headers as sent: SUV from the tags as they are, slices in instance order, every send counted, patients keyed by site ID, no calibration check, no queries to sites, every extracted fact kept, headers and text passed on
labels.no_decay_reference: Dose always decayed to scan start, whatever the image's DecayCorrection says
labels.no_dedupe: A re-sent series counts as another scan
labels.no_deid: Headers and documents passed on as received
labels.no_linkage: Patients keyed by site and site ID, so a referral is two people
labels.no_slice_rules: Slices in instance-number order, no gap check
labels.no_term_checks: Every fact the reader proposes is kept; new terms enter on first sight
labels.no_timing_rule: Uptake time used as computed, even when negative
labels.no_unit_rules: Weight and dose used as sent
labels.pipeline: Plausibility rules that refuse and query, decay reference respected, slices by position with gap check, duplicates removed, patients linked across sites, liver-reference calibration check, code-checked facts and induced terms, allowlist de-identification
